description.value:
Once you reach 5th level, you gain the following racial trait.
As an action, you give a harsh spin of your wings that detaches up to 5 feather darts (taking 1 chaos damage for each) to create a 5ft twister adjacent to you. The vortex violently spins with sharpened feathers for 1 minute or until a large enough gust of wind can disperse it.
Any creature who moves into the vortex’s space on their turn, or else starts their turn inside of it, takes 1d4 slashing damage for each feather dart used to make the vortex.
